prompt: 我明天想要操作台股強勢股，可以幫我挑出前五大值得關注的標的嗎？請結合大盤趨勢、三大法人持股變化以及最新的利多/利空新聞來分析，並把處置股或已經大跌跌停的股票排除掉。請使用 HTML 格式 (watch_list_analysis.html) 產生一個美觀的儀表板報告。

assertions.name: selects_5_stocks
assertions.description: Verify that exactly 5 stocks are selected as the top recommended stocks.

assertions.name: excludes_3481_and_2324
assertions.description: Verify that both 3481 and 2324 are excluded from the top 5 watchlist.

assertions.name: contains_chip_analysis
assertions.description: Verify that the report contains analysis of institutional flows/chips.

assertions.name: contains_news_sentiment
assertions.description: Verify that the report contains analysis of recent news sentiment.
